parameters.content:
## Social Fetch - Threads

Official Threads API (`graph.threads.com`, **not** the Facebook/Instagram Graph API -- separate app, separate token).

1. `GET /{user-id}/threads` -> latest 50 posts (needs `threads_basic`).
2. `GET /{media-id}/insights?metric=views,likes,replies,reposts,quotes` per post (needs `threads_manage_insights`).

Row mapping: views=views, likes=likes, comments=replies, shares=reposts+quotes. Reposts of other people's posts (REPOST_FACADE) are skipped.

### Credentials (one per account)
Query Auth, **Name = access_token**, Value = long-lived token. channel `Brand A` uses the *(Brand A)* HTTP nodes, any other channel uses the *(Brand B)* nodes -- select the matching credential on each.

### Token
Long-lived tokens last 60 days. Refresh before expiry: `GET https://graph.threads.com/refresh_access_token?grant_type=th_refresh_token&access_token=<token>` and paste the new token into the credential.
